recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not remove CompartmentDefinition.title unless FHIR-I revisits FHIR-37455 or issues a newer decision; no core-source follow-up is needed for FHIR-12914.
issue_request: FHIR-12914 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request for DSTU2 asking to remove CompartmentDefinition.jurisdiction and CompartmentDefinition.title because compartment definitions are HL7-defined and tied to the resource they describe.
initial_application: The request was applied in SVN revision 13984, represented in git by db6d6b7c65c3ebda5fe2967ac61ce70e779b0863, which removed CompartmentDefinition.title and CompartmentDefinition.jurisdiction rows from the historical CompartmentDefinition spreadsheet source.
additional_context: The current CompartmentDefinition StructureDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini and derives from CanonicalResource. Current source still has no CompartmentDefinition.jurisdiction element. FHIR-37455 later reached Published/Persuasive status and explicitly added title back to CompartmentDefinition and GraphDefinition for R5 because title was useful on those CanonicalResource resources. FHIR-I minutes record the FHIR-37455 motion, and a methodology Zulip thread supports the split that title is acceptable while jurisdiction remains useless/fixed.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change was made because the current source already reflects the surviving part of FHIR-12914, and removing title now would conflict with the later FHIR-37455 decision.
